body.statement:
Write this library. A library is four modules of definitions, one per line: `def <name> <arity> : <program>`, where arity is 1 to 3; `#` starts a comment. A program is whitespace-separated tokens run on a stack of integers: an integer pushes itself; `a`, `b` and `c` push the inputs; `+ - *` pop two values and push the result; `< > =` pop two values and push 1 or 0; `neg` negates the top; `dup` copies it; `swap` swaps the top two; `c x y ?` pushes x if c is not 0, else y; `name@` calls the library's function `name`, popping as many values as it takes (the deepest is its `a`) and pushing its result. A program must leave exactly one value. Arithmetic wraps around on 64-bit overflow. A program stops with an error after 10000 steps or 64 nested calls. A module with a line that doesn't parse contributes nothing, and a name defined twice counts as undefined.

Module base:
- abs(a): the absolute value of a (abs of the most negative integer is itself)
- sign(a): -1 if a < 0, 0 if a = 0, 1 if a > 0
- max2(a, b): the larger of a and b
- min2(a, b): the smaller of a and b
- inc(a): a + 1
- dec(a): a - 1
- sq(a): a * a
- iszero(a): 1 if a = 0, else 0

Module order:
- clamp3(x, lo, hi): min2(max2(x, lo), hi)
- median3(a, b, c): the middle one of a, b and c
- max3(a, b, c): the largest of a, b and c
- min3(a, b, c): the smallest of a, b and c
- between(x, lo, hi): 1 if lo <= x <= hi, else 0
- cmp(a, b): -1 if a < b, 0 if a = b, 1 if a > b
- dist(a, b): abs(a - b)
- nearer(x, p, q): p if dist(x, p) <= dist(x, q), else q

Module arith:
- sumsq(a, b): sq(a) + sq(b)
- cube(a): a * sq(a)
- poly(a): 2 * sq(a) - 3 * a + 1
- mulsign(a, b): abs(a) * sign(b)
- clampsq(a, lo, hi): sq(a) limited to lo..hi, that is min2(max2(sq(a), lo), hi)
- manhattan(a, b): abs(a) + abs(b)
- path3(a, b, c): dist(a, b) + dist(b, c)
- relu(a): max2(a, 0)

Module shape:
- near2(a, b, r): 1 if manhattan(a, b) <= r, else 0
- snap(x, lo, hi): whichever of lo and hi is nearer to x limited to lo..hi: nearer(min2(max2(x, lo), hi), lo, hi)
- spread3(a, b, c): max3(a, b, c) - min3(a, b, c)
- energy(a, b): sumsq(a, b) - dist(a, b)
- bucket(a): sign(a) * min2(max2(abs(a), 0), 3)
- flat3(a, b, c): 1 if a, b and c are all equal, else 0
Implement max2(a, b): the larger of a and b.
Implement min2(a, b): the smaller of a and b.
Implement inc(a): a + 1.
Implement dec(a): a - 1.
Implement sq(a): a * a.
Implement iszero(a): 1 if a = 0, else 0.
Implement median3(a, b, c): the middle one of a, b and c.
Implement max3(a, b, c): the largest of a, b and c.
Implement min3(a, b, c): the smallest of a, b and c.
Implement cmp(a, b): -1 if a < b, 0 if a = b, 1 if a > b.
Implement dist(a, b): abs(a - b).
Implement sumsq(a, b): sq(a) + sq(b).
Implement cube(a): a * sq(a).
Implement poly(a): 2 * sq(a) - 3 * a + 1.
Implement mulsign(a, b): abs(a) * sign(b).
Implement clampsq(a, lo, hi): sq(a) limited to lo..hi, that is min2(max2(sq(a), lo), hi).
Implement manhattan(a, b): abs(a) + abs(b).
Implement path3(a, b, c): dist(a, b) + dist(b, c).
Implement relu(a): max2(a, 0).
Implement near2(a, b, r): 1 if manhattan(a, b) <= r, else 0.
Implement snap(x, lo, hi): whichever of lo and hi is nearer to x limited to lo..hi: nearer(min2(max2(x, lo), hi), lo, hi).
Implement energy(a, b): sumsq(a, b) - dist(a, b).
Implement bucket(a): sign(a) * min2(max2(abs(a), 0), 3).
Implement flat3(a, b, c): 1 if a, b and c are all equal, else 0.

body.statement: Change request: clamp3 now takes its inputs as (lo, hi, x) instead of (x, lo, hi). Every function that calls it must pass them in the new order.
Implement clamp3(lo, hi, x): min2(max2(x, lo), hi).
Change request: sign(0) is now 1: sign returns -1 for negative inputs and 1 for all others. Functions defined in terms of sign follow it.
Implement sign(a): -1 if a < 0, else 1.
Change request: nearer now breaks ties toward q: it returns p only if p is strictly nearer to x. Functions defined in terms of nearer follow it.
Implement nearer(x, p, q): p if dist(x, p) < dist(x, q), else q.
Change request: between now excludes hi: it is 1 if lo <= x < hi.
Implement between(x, lo, hi): 1 if lo <= x < hi, else 0.
Change request: abs no longer wraps: abs(-9223372036854775808) is now 9223372036854775807. Functions defined in terms of abs follow it.
Implement abs(a): the absolute value of a, except that abs of the most negative integer is the most positive one.
Change request: spread3 now counts the integers from the smallest input to the largest, both included: max3 - min3 + 1. Code that relies on spread3 must allow for it.
Implement spread3(a, b, c): max3(a, b, c) - min3(a, b, c) + 1, the number of integers from the smallest to the largest.
